Source: PR2681 at `ea96706295631be10d92ae149b63c3e24acaeabc`; current canonical main `1884c509efc004524786e9b7cfcc4aca572316d5`, priority revision 5. This responds to the failed cost comparison with a different physical frame implementation, retaining the same logical word and endpoints.

Bounded question: can the future-chart sweep use the common frame on axes 9..24, with a charged signed rank-one normalization at each of its 112 source/output roles, instead of upgrading every output to F25 and back? The source-exact phase screen and full symbolic prototype pass: each stage 2 map sends F17 to the common 16-axis frame times C_q using an explicitly computed affine shift; C_q^-1 enters the common frame and C_q plus the inverse map restores F17. All 224 current fields remain borrowed and untouched. These are provisional local measurements pending the independent native/source controls.

This changes the child-cost decision, while the larger scalar/map/wrapper costs, physical hosting, movement, precision and output consumer remain explicit obligations; none are zero. No full supplier, optimum or kappa claim. The existing source's logical inverse, source reconstruction and scalar word retain full credit.

Bounded deliverable: one source-pinned transformed word, exact dynamic frame/affine-map proof, all signed rank-one native kernels and occurrences, complete arbitrary-input/dirty-restoration replay, meaningful missing/wrong normalization/shift/return controls, and full local comparison. Stop before a new family search or supplier expansion; reopen only with a pinned favorable complete consumer allowance. The picker originally selected verifier engineering; TASK will record the evidence-driven pivot from saturated acceptance-boundary audits to this concrete newly published source handoff.

This is a narrowed local-module result, not an optimization campaign.
